summary: # CLO International Academic Month Issue 4 (Part 1): Digital Fashion and Creative Design ## Introduction In this video, I will share the results of our current exploration into digital technology, intelligent technology, and fashion innovation, combined with insights from fashion designers, scholars, experts, and researchers. I will mainly share from two aspects: 1. The demand for modern lifestyle and fashion industry development. 2. The demand for digital technology and fashion design innovation. ## Demand for Modern Lifestyle and Fashion Industry Development The demand for modern lifestyle and fashion industry development is based on three main aspects: ### 1. Modern Cultural Background and Fashion Style The first aspect is the trend of modern cultural backgrounds and fashion styles. ### 2. Digital Infrastructure and Fashion Innovation The second aspect is the new foundation of digital infrastructure and fashion innovation. ### 3. Efficiency of Fashion Design The third aspect is how digitalization can improve the efficiency of fashion design. ### 4. Economic Development Additionally, we must consider the demand for economic development to meet the needs of our future material culture, agriculture, and industrial information civilization. ### 5. Globalized Vision and Big Data The globalized vision under the background of big data plays a crucial role. Furthermore, the digitalization of intelligent information culture, fashion, and lifestyle is increasingly apparent. The rapid development of digital technology provides a new environment for fashion industry design, leading to the digitalization of our modern lives. ## Modern Lifestyle Changes We can no longer live without computers and mobile phones. Our shopping, consumption, and entertainment revolve around digitalization. In this context, we need to study the direction of our modern lifestyle. For instance, Beijing recently released new lifestyle trends, including various activities such as home cultivation, spiritual practices, and retrograde behaviors. ### Four Aspects of Lifestyle I summarized these changes in modern lifestyle into four aspects: 1. Meeting the basic needs of physical health. 2. Meeting the needs of social function and diversification in society. 3. Individualization of lifestyle that respects personal demands. 4. Achieving artistic preservation of self-value and mental needs. ## Transformation in the Fashion Industry The transformation of lifestyle drives three significant changes in the fashion industry: - From focus to distribution. - From group to individuality. - From market to customer. ### Strategic Leadership Such changes are supported by the strategic leadership of our country's policies. We have received national recognition in the digital technology system from the plans of 14.5 and the original plan of 2035. The industrialization and digitalization of intelligent design have become the current direction of development, primarily driven by the Internet, artificial intelligence, big data, virtual reality, and smart manufacturing. ### Fashion Needs and Digital Technology To better meet the fashion needs of the new lifestyle, we must explore how digital and cultural innovation, content production, and security can combine with various industries to create a cross-border Internet. ## Digital Fashion Design Research Center At our fashion academy, we have established a digital fashion design research center to build a digital fashion brand. The digitalization of fashion products can be categorized into four aspects: 1. Digitalization of resources. 2. Digitalization of production management. 3. Digitalization of operation management. 4. Digitalization of quality control. ### Cloud Software in Fashion Cloud software has penetrated the entire fashion industry, from inspiration and investigation to final operation management. We currently have brands capable of carrying out digital design applications and management throughout the process. ## Intelligent Fashion Design Production The intelligentization of fashion design production is based on materials, human resources, financial supply, and design of supply production control. The foundation of this business lies in trend prediction, which I particularly emphasize. ### Technology Supply and Data Information Data information for business management and customer information relies on numerous business management systems, including ERP, OAS, MES, and AI trend prediction systems. This allows for data fusion and high-resolution virtual imaging, constructing six intelligent big data platforms that differ from traditional design production. ### Innovative Processes in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises In Hangzhou, many small and medium-sized clothing companies have adopted such processes extensively, particularly in foreign trade, facilitating communication during the epidemic and providing convenience and efficiency for fashion design. ## Research and Development in Fashion The usual operation of our clothing brand processes involves research and development projects, from fabric collection to final production. The positioning of the crowd—whether young, middle-aged, or older—affects fashion sense and availability. ### Traditional vs. Digital Research Traditional research relied heavily on manpower, while modern processes depend on data. This shift includes product selection and detail determination, involving interviews and various design elements. ### Digital Rich Fashion Design Digital rich fashion design utilizes AI design and AI trend prediction to quickly collect relevant images and documents from the entire network. By combining business brand positioning and historical sales data, designers can improve efficiency in pattern design and creation. ## Communication and Sampling in Fashion Design Fashion design intellectualization is primarily reflected in 3D design software, virtual reality test platforms, and diversified data channels. Most designers today still use flat design software; however, 3D design allows for near 100% virtual fabric simulations, covering texture, color, and material. ### Electronic Samples and Virtual Mapping Companies now create electronic samples and electronic crafts, adjusting all aspects of seams and fabric through virtual mapping. Customers can view and share designs on this platform. ## Innovation through Digital Technology ### Interaction between Images and Design The interaction between images, design, and production is foundational. Digital technology drives innovation in image design, allowing for unique creations based on visual inputs. ### Three-Dimensional Software and Pattern Division Three-dimensional software is used for pattern re-creation and division, employing algorithmic art forms to produce symmetric designs. Software like Mander and Sandy assists in creating diverse patterns based on artistic formulas. ### Parameter-Guided Production Automatic production guided by parameters utilizes tools like Everypile to adjust multi-parameters, generating unique patterns based on designer preferences. ## Digital Pattern Composition and Design The MiHui smart flower platform in the Jiangzhe area showcases a variety of patterns, utilizing AI to analyze market trends and predict popular designs. This platform facilitates color analysis and smart transmission management systems. ### New Materials and Technology The fashion industry is exploring the use of new materials, such as ultra-high-precision 3D digital fabric simulation technology. This approach promotes the development of a green technology ecosystem. ## Virtual Era and Fashion The arrival of the virtual era means that digital models and multicultural scenes are becoming integral to fashion. Our school is working on integrating real and virtual shows. ## Style Identification in Fashion Design Style identification is crucial for effective design. Automatic replacements and objective analysis help ensure that designs resonate with audiences. ### Digitalization of Traditional Silk Our team is dedicated to the digitalization of traditional silk, showcasing its unique characteristics through virtual technology. ## Conclusion To summarize, the characteristics of digital fashion include: 1. Diversity of fashion. 2. Democratization of fashion personality. 3. Fashion ecology. 4. Digital coalescence of technology and design. These elements illustrate the future of digital fashion and the innovative work we are pursuing in this field. Please share your comments and suggestions. Thank you.
